item: Dead #corpus-win modal code and the uncalled client reindex/prune cores removed; their pins re-anchored to the live paths
summary: Deleted the retired #corpus-win dialog markup and corpus-subtabs nav, corpusTab, renderCorpusSources/Keywords/Competitive, _mmKitHome, the #mm-kit-home anchor and the _corpusTerm/_corpusTab/_corpusSubtabs state (no caller since THEME-3), plus the uncalled client cores _reindexAllLoop/_pruneCore/_reindexAllRunning. Nothing user-visible changes. Pins re-anchored, not dropped: the five corpus-window subtab tests now assert the same properties on the live #an window (Mindmap via loadAnalysis + /api/insights/graph + renderAnMindmap; Sentiment via corpus-sentiment with the visible VADER English-only caveat; Keywords via corpus-keywords chips + the keyword-stats hover cooccur/PMI; Sources via corpus-sources + _anSourcesHtml/_anSourceCatalogHtml asserted-not-deduced; Competitive via renderAnCompetitive/_anCompetitiveHtml incl. _score_leak). Invariant 18's third adopter is now ooSubtabs(an-subtabs). The prune/reindex pins read _startReindexJob + reindex-job prune_after + the job's prune_orphan_keywords/reindex_all_batch, and the _pruneCore exemption became a test that the prune-after job is started only from cleanupKeywords behind its confirm. /api/insights/reindex-all and /prune-keywords are listed superseded in routes_without_ui.tsv. Frozen-renderer list and slicer budget (230 to 222) lowered.
